title: Orchestration Control Contract v1
description: The deterministic subset of engine output that n8n routes on. Deliberately small. Report formatting, deep extraction and client-facing output contracts are separate and deferred. n8n must never parse free-text prose to decide what runs next.

CASE_VERSION.description: Case version this run read. Engine 6 increments; other engines echo. 0 is reserved for knowledge-clock runs (Engine 7 FOUNDATION, UPDATE, INBOX) which are not attached to any client case; real client case versions begin at 1 and client_case_versions.case_version >= 1 enforces that, so 0 can never denote a genuine case.

ENGINE_RUN_STATUS.description: The engine's own assessment. Distinct from engine_runs.status, which is the orchestrator's.

REVIEW_REQUIRED.description: Engine requests practitioner review before downstream work proceeds.

HOLD_FLAG_PRESENT.description: LLM-raised hold. Additive only: it can create a flag, never clear a deterministic one.

MEDICAL_COORDINATION_PRESENT.description: Engine 1 Part 18 / Engine 4 Part 21 populated. Does not by itself block release; the deterministic rule set decides HOLD vs NOTE.

LIVE_RESEARCH_REQUIRED.description: Engine 7 case mode: library coverage inadequate, escalate to targeted live research.

KNOWLEDGE_SUFFICIENT.description: Engine 7: existing library answers the case question. When false and LIVE_RESEARCH_REQUIRED is false, the gap is recorded rather than researched.

CURRENT_DECISION.description: Engine 4 section 48. Several may apply in reasoning; this field carries the primary decision that routing acts on.

NEXT_ENGINE.description: Explicit next step. NONE ends the cycle; REVIEW parks it in the practitioner queue.

LOOP_COUNT.description: Routing depth within the current cycle. Compared against case_cycles.max_loops before any re-route.

RESEARCH_QUESTIONS.description: Engine 1 Pass A output. Consumed by Engine 7 case mode. Empty on Pass B.

NORMALIZATION_PHRASES.description: Clinical phrases the engine used, handed to the normalization layer for concept resolution. Engines are never asked to emit canonical keys themselves.

allOf.description: A routing recommendation must name a reason, so the practitioner can see why a case moved.
Live research is only escalated when the library was found insufficient.
A failed run must say why.
